content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant, and the Tenant hereby rents from the Landlord, the premises hereinafter described.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: The term of this Lease shall commence on the date hereof and shall continue until the expiration of the initial term of five (5) years, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rent
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $3,500 per month, payable on the first day of each month.
